---

[4] guide — Catalog cache
Source: docs/guide.md:9-13

## Catalog cache

The catalog cache stores the provider model list with a timestamp.
A failed refresh may use the last cached list, marked stale.

---

[5] concept — Problem
Source: .agents/tasks/alice/TKT-0001-0025/TKT-0001/concept.md:14-17

## Problem

The catalog cache has no fallback when the refresh fails.
